definition_zh: 土体随冻结和融化反复经历的温度及状态循环。

P076.title: Long-term freeze–thaw cycle behavior of high-speed railway embankment in frozen soil regions and its effects on train-track dynamic interaction system
P076.authors: Z Li, W Wang, L Xu, B Peng
P076.label: Li等（2024）

complete_examples.text: Through an illustrative example, the evolution characteristics of the freeze-thaw cycle behavior of embankment is fully revealed.

The high-speed railway embankment built in cold regions has a long-term freeze-thaw cycle behavior, and the frost heave of soil will inevitably affect the smoothness of the track structure laid on the embankment, resulting in the deterioration of the train running performance and the dynamic behavior of the ballastless track system.
